entries.fa52f6fd032bcc5f: The women's underwear and related business is a core business accounting for most of consolidated net sales, with net sales to external customers of ¥18,589 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. It sells body-shaping women's underwear at directly managed stores nationwide and on EC sites, and at directly managed stores, it provides after-sales services such as body makeup even after providing products, maintaining relationships with customers that continue after purchase. In the current fiscal year, due to factors such as the introduction of new colors in its mainstay product series, the purchase unit price of existing customers increased, and the business had higher revenue.
